spans.s:
ग्रैव^1 n. ग्रैवेय m. n. the chain on the neck of an
elephant.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20160412. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/275. note: headword missing 'r'.
ग्रैवेयक n. the same, necklace, collar i.g.
ग्रै॑व्य a. relating to the neck.
ग्रै॑ष्म a. relating to the summer.
ग्रैष्मिक a. relating to the summer.
